title: Warehouse Operator
description: Official Samsung E&A warehouse role in Saudi Arabia for the Fadhili Gas Increment Program Project, with listing metadata pointing to Jubail. The role focuses on maintaining an organized warehouse for site operations, handling material request and issue-slip records, managing material reports, checking and cleaning stored material, issuing materials to construction teams, confirming material quantity and integrity, tracking periodic balance quantities, moving and picking materials, and confirming material locations by specification. The listing asks for basic warehouse knowledge in the oil and gas industry and 1 to 4 years of relevant experience.
